article_summary: The article describes a dual light-activated cooperative catalysis system combining molecular iodine and photoredox catalysis for the intramolecular amination of benzylic C(sp3)-H bonds. Iodine acts as the primary catalyst for 1,5-hydrogen atom transfer (1,5-HAT) via an in situ generated N-I bond, while the organic photoredox catalyst TPT (2,4,6-triphenylpyrylium tetrafluoroborate) reoxidizes the resulting HI back to molecular iodine using oxygen as the terminal oxidant. This metal-free approach enables the synthesis of various pyrrolidines and isoindolines under visible-light irradiation.
